hero.subtitle: I build governed, interoperable and reliable data products and platforms that drive decisions with real impact.
hero.trajectoryIntro.0: My career started with strong foundations in software and data engineering and evolved into a broader profile where platform thinking, data governance, clinical interoperability, and end-to-end quality work together as one capability. I have worked across banking, product, and digital health, building solutions that needed to be reliable, operable, and useful for real decisions.
hero.trajectoryIntro.1: That path helped me combine hands-on execution, architectural judgment, and product thinking to turn complex data problems into reusable capabilities. Today I do not bring only pipelines or integrations, but trust structures around data: standards, quality, metadata, traceability, and lifecycle control.
hero.layers.0.title: Governance layer
hero.layers.0.text: Cataloging, metadata, and ownership centralized with DataHub to make data understandable and governable.
hero.layers.1.title: Interoperability layer
hero.layers.1.text: Clinical data transformation toward HL7 FHIR and OMOP for operational exchange and advanced analytics.
hero.layers.2.title: Quality & lifecycle layer
hero.layers.2.text: Data quality, observability, and data offboarding to track data from ingestion to blocking or deletion.
hero.proofPoints.0.title: Governance applied to product

hero.proofPoints.1.title: Clinical interoperability with purpose

hero.proofPoints.2.title: Quality, traceability, and control
hero.proofPoints.2.body: I work across the full data lifecycle, from ingestion and validation to monitoring, blocking, or deletion.

summary.heading: Executive summary
summary.lead: At Savana, I design and evolve data products and platforms where engineering, governance, and interoperability work together to make data useful, traceable, and trustworthy.
summary.paragraphs.0: My focus is on turning complex integration, quality, and analytics needs into real product capabilities: cataloging, metadata, validation, observability, visualization, and lifecycle control.
summary.paragraphs.1: I combine hands-on execution, architectural judgment, and technical leadership to translate regulated environments and complex requirements into more solid, reusable systems that are ready to generate value.
summary.pillars.0.label: Product
summary.pillars.0.text: I think in reusable capabilities, not one-off solutions.
summary.pillars.1.label: Platform
summary.pillars.1.text: I connect data, processes, metadata, and visualization with an end-to-end mindset.
summary.pillars.2.label: Impact
summary.pillars.2.text: I translate technical decisions into quality, interoperability, and operational control.
about.heading: About
about.paragraphs.0: I work at the intersection of data engineering, data governance, and product. My focus is on turning complex requirements into stronger, auditable, interoperable platforms that create real value for technical and business teams.
about.paragraphs.1: I specialize in data governance, interoperability, and end-to-end quality, building solutions that connect metadata, cataloging, validation, observability, and operational control at scale. I hold the CDMP (Associate) certification from DAMA International, I am an active member of DAMA Spain and keep my expertise current through continuous learning, certifications, and hands-on work.
about.paragraphs.2: I also see documentation, mentoring, and knowledge transfer as essential parts of technical scalability and strong teams.
experience.spotlight.heading: Savana
experience.spotlight.title: From data engineering to leading Data Management
experience.spotlight.paragraphs.0: At Savana, I moved from a hands-on engineering role to leading the Data Management area, with a cross-functional view of data quality, interoperability, and governance, while staying close to solution design and product thinking.
experience.spotlight.paragraphs.1: I drove interoperability capabilities around HL7 FHIR, the modern HL7 specification for healthcare data exchange, and OMOP CDM, the common data model promoted by OHDSI for standardization and advanced analytics. This allowed me to connect operational integration, analytics enablement, and real business needs across the clinical data ecosystem.
experience.spotlight.paragraphs.2: I also designed and evolved a data quality platform from scratch, aligned with the UNE 0081 data quality standard and built on open source tooling, until it became a reusable capability ready for API-based integration. This was complemented by metadata and catalog centralization on DataHub, as well as lifecycle monitoring and visualization solutions, including the evolution of the Data Model Explorer from Power BI to Apache Superset.
experience.spotlight.paragraphs.3: This work was completed by data offboarding processes focused on compliance, security, and operational control, making it possible to track data from ingestion to blocking or deletion.
experience.spotlight.focus.0: Clinical interoperability with HL7 FHIR and OMOP CDM
experience.spotlight.focus.1: Data quality as a product capability
experience.spotlight.focus.2: Catalog, metadata, and lineage on DataHub
experience.timeline.0.text: Senior Data Engineer (2022), Lead Data Engineer (2023) and Head of Data Management (2025). Clinical interoperability with HL7 FHIR and OMOP CDM, data quality aligned with UNE 0081, catalogue and metadata in DataHub, and data lifecycle management.
experience.timeline.1.text: I strengthened an end-to-end understanding of data by working on a platform that connected ingestion, processing, modeling, governance, observability, and analytics. I designed integration and analytics processes on Apache Spark and worked on use cases where data needed to be reliable, explainable, and operable at scale.
experience.timeline.2.text: I contributed to a high-performance banking platform across batch and streaming environments, working with technologies such as Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Apache Kafka, and Hazelcast in contexts where operational reliability was critical.
experience.timeline.3.text: I participated in the modernization of data solutions for pensions, investment funds, and corporate analytics, connecting automation, cloud, and business utility in migrations from on-premise environments to AWS.
experience.timeline.4.text: My first professional stage in social and geographic analytics, where I built an early foundation in data processing, business context, and solution delivery.
